evals.name: run-cli-generic
evals.prompt: Run the ShapeShifter CLI on my model.onnx to transform the graph.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run first
The plan writes a ShapeShifter YAML and runs `quark-cli shapeshifter`

evals.name: fold-batch-norm
evals.prompt: Fold the BatchNorm nodes in resnet50.onnx into the preceding Convs.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses the onnx_fold_batch_norm pass with fold_batch_norm: true

evals.name: simplify-graph
evals.prompt: Constant-fold and simplify my mobilenet.onnx graph.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_simplify with simplify: true

evals.name: convert-opset
evals.prompt: Upgrade my model.onnx opset to 21 using ShapeShifter.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_convert_opset_version with target_opset_version: 21

evals.name: fuse-layernorm
evals.prompt: Fuse the LayerNorm subgraphs in my transformer.onnx into single LayerNormalization ops.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_fuse_layer_norm

evals.name: nchw-to-nhwc
evals.prompt: Convert my model.onnx from NCHW to NHWC layout.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_convert_nchw_to_nhwc

evals.name: cross-layer-equalization
evals.prompt: Run cross-layer equalization on resnet.onnx before I quantize it.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_cross_layer_equalization with cross_layer_equalization: true

evals.name: preprocess-before-quant
evals.prompt: Preprocess my float model.onnx with ShapeShifter passes before quantization.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
Passes are treated as preprocessing on the float model

evals.name: postprocess-xint8
evals.prompt: Postprocess my quantized model_quant.onnx for XINT8/NPU with ShapeShifter.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_xint8_adjust and/or onnx_xint8_simulate on the quantized Q/DQ model

evals.name: align-scale-quantized
evals.prompt: Align the Q/DQ scales across Concat and MaxPool in my quantized graph.
expectations: Claude invokes quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
The config uses onnx_align_scale with align_scale including Concat and MaxPool

evals.name: negative-create-pass
evals.prompt: Help me write a new onnx_ ShapeShifter pass that drops Identity nodes.
expectations: Claude does NOT invoke quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
Claude routes to quark-create-shapeshifter-pass (authoring, not running)

evals.name: negative-full-quantization
evals.prompt: Quantize my resnet50.onnx to XINT8 end to end.
expectations: Claude does NOT invoke quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run as the primary skill
Claude routes to quark-onnx-ptq for the full PTQ pipeline

evals.name: negative-pytorch-model
evals.prompt: Remove dropout from my model.pt with a ShapeShifter pass.
expectations: Claude does NOT invoke quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run (input is PyTorch .pt, not .onnx)
Claude does not feed a .pt file into an ONNX-only skill

evals.name: negative-error-traceback
evals.prompt: quark-cli shapeshifter crashed with an onnxruntime CUDAExecutionProvider error.
expectations: Claude does NOT invoke quark-onnx-shapeshifter-run
Claude routes to quark-onnx-debug for the traceback

evals.name: silent-no-op-missing-flag
evals.prompt: I added onnx_convert_clip_to_relu to my config but the Clip nodes are still in the output .onnx.
expectations: Diagnosis names the missing/false enable flag (convert_clip_to_relu) as the cause
Fix sets convert_clip_to_relu: true in the pass config
Explanation notes the Engine passes the raw config through without applying pass defaults
